title: Errors
text:
# Errors
## Common error codes
- ERR_AUTH_001: Authentication failed
- ERR_TXN_002: Transaction not found
- ERR_LIMIT_003: Daily limit exceeded
## Handling
Return a user-friendly message and include a support reference id.

title: Features
text:
# Features
PayJack supports:
- Balance lookup
- Transaction search (by date range, amount, merchant)
- Spend summaries by category
- Recurring transaction detection

title: Fees
text:
# Fees
## Transfer fees (example)
- Wallet-to-wallet: 0.0 GHS
- Wallet-to-bank: 1.0% (min 1.00 GHS)
Fees may vary by product tier and transaction amount.

title: Help Center
text:
# Help Center
## FAQs
**Q: How do I reverse a transfer?**
A: Some transfers are final. For disputes, contact support with the transaction reference.
**Q: Why was my transaction declined?**
A: Common reasons include insufficient balance, limits, or compliance checks.

title: Limits
text:
# Limits
## Daily limits (example)
- Transfers: 10,000 GHS/day
- Cashout: 5,000 GHS/day
If a user hits a limit, return ERR_LIMIT_003 and suggest waiting or upgrading tier.
